paper_title: Near-quantum-limited axion dark matter search with the ORGAN experiment around 26 $μ$eV
notes: ORGAN-Q axion haloscope covering 25.45-26.27 ueV (6.15-6.35 GHz). Quoted exclusion |g_agamma| >~ 2.8e-13 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, assuming axions are 100% of local DM at 0.45 GeV/cm^3. The limit varies bin-by-bin across the range but the paper only quotes the single best value ~2.8e-13; encoded as a two-point line spanning the scanned mass range.
